title: finding(pm-skills): SKILL.md never defines a 轮 (round) — the hourly self-timer, the shift-end brief and the per-round report read as a stop, so the triage seat clears about a dozen cards per fire instead of running to empty
body:
Filed by the skills seat (session `session_019RfFHiRCSs3JXLK4cwcfox`, os-steve) from the maintainer's live PM chat, 2026-09-04 14:5xZ. Self-triaged into this lane: the fix is prose in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` and its digest, both owned here.

## What the maintainer observed (verbatim, untranslated)

> 分诊席的 skills 是不是也有问题：你的轮次报告什么意思，你每个轮次到底处理哪些任务，明明很多卡片还没处理完你为什么就停了

> 每个小时都在跑，跑了好几天，积压了这么多卡

The triage seat's own reading, pasted in the same chat: it had cleared 11 cards, written its round report and stopped, with the queue not empty and the usage window not exhausted; two repositories hold 424 cards with no `domain:*` label (objectstack 43 %, objectui 51 %). It resumed on the maintainer's word.

## The rule exists — and it says the opposite of what the seat did

`SKILL.md` on `main` `a12b15e3`, the sweep section: 首触定级每轮必做,跑到清空 — ⛔ 无每轮总量预算,清得动就多清;窗口耗尽未跑完的,下一 fire 从断点续跑;单轮数小时同为可接受形态,⛔ 不是封顶总量的理由. The finding section repeats it: 每 fire 跑到清空, and adds fire 到达时上一轮未清空 ⇒ 接续处理,轮次可跨 fire. Nothing in the corpus authorises stopping at eleven.

## Why a careful reader stops anyway — the defect is in the surrounding text, not in that rule

1. **A 轮 is never defined.** The word carries four meanings across the file — a fire (one wake-up), the select→claim→dispatch→collect→review→report cycle, a batch (每批 ≤5 张同族卡), and a shift (收班). The sweep rule says 每轮跑到清空; the entry section says 未收班活动任一未满一个轮次 ⇒ 自退; the report section says 每轮向维护者打轮次报告. A reader who takes 轮 = fire concludes that a fire ends with a report.
2. **The self-timer reads as the length of a round.** 自排定时默认收班时挂、延时 ≤55 分钟 is a prompt-cache convenience (the rationale is written beside it), but 收班时挂 says the timer is armed at shift end, so every hour becomes a shift end. The timer is the NEXT wake-up, not a budget for this one; the text never says so.
3. **The round report reads as a terminal act.** The report section prescribes what the report contains and never says that writing it does not end the work. The handover brief (收班简报) is described as the final stroke of a shift (简报是最终一笔); a seat that conflates the report with the brief stops after the report.
4. **Shift-end and wave-end vocabulary belongs to the executing seat** (收工点 = 会话内在飞归零, 收工存档, 立即派下一波) and is written in the shared section. The triage seat has no in-flight PRs to reach zero, so it applies the nearest thing: its own report.
5. **The batch cap reads as a per-round cap.** 每批 ≤5 张同族卡 is a quality rule (read five same-family cards in one context), placed one sentence after 跑到清空; a reader keeps the five and drops the run-to-empty.

Net effect measured by the maintainer: an hourly seat that clears about a dozen cards per fire for days, against a backlog that run-to-empty would have drained in two.

## The fix (rules only, plain language — the programme's ruling of 2026-09-04)

Add to the digest and to the SKILL.md rewrite, under 入口与角色, two rules with no story attached:

- 一轮从 fire 醒来开始,到队列清空或用量窗口耗尽为止;轮次报告是轮末给维护者的汇报,⛔ 不是停止信号。
- 自设定时器只定下一次唤醒,不定本轮长度;新 fire 到达时上一轮未清空的,接续处理,⛔ 不重开、不重排。

And in the SKILL.md rewrite: define 轮 / fire / 批 / 班 once, in one sentence each, and use each word for one thing only; move 收工点 and 收工存档 under the executing seat's section, where they apply.

## Disposition

Executed inside #15379: the digest (PR #15402, member 1) takes the two rules now as a patch round, at the same 150-line ceiling (two existing lines merge to pay for them; the dev names which); member 1b (the SKILL.md rewrite) carries the definitions and the vocabulary discipline and closes this card with `Fixes`. `pm:dispatched` on the same family flight.
